dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A kilo of pork and a jar of honey.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈkiːloʊ əv ˈpɔːrk ənd ə ˈdʒɑːr əv ˈhʌni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. I need some bread for breakfast, too.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈniːd sʌm ˈbrɛd fər ˈbrɛkfəst, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How about this bread? It has twenty slices.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈbrɛd? ɪt ˈhæz ˈtwɛnti ˈslaɪsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. I usually have two slices of toast in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈhæv ˈtuː ˈslaɪsɪz əv ˈtoʊst ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Look! The chocolate cake is cheap today.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk! ðə ˈtʃɔːklət ˈkeɪk ɪz ˈtʃiːp təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! A piece of cake for you, and a piece for me.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ə ˈpiːs əv ˈkeɪk fər juː, ənd ə ˈpiːs fər miː.
